save_quantized_model_llmcompressor: save a quantized PyTorch model in the LLM-Compressor format to a specified output directory
construct_quantization_scheme: construct a compressed_tensors QuantizationScheme from an auto_round layer with weight and activation args
pack_quantized_layer: pack a single quantized layer by setting its quantization scheme, scale, and zero point attributes
get_weight_scheme_strategy: get the quantization strategy string for weights based on a given group_size value
get_act_scheme_strategy: get the quantization strategy string for activations based on a given group_size value
